## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expected behavior is explicit.
- [ ] Relevant regression cases are covered or limitations documented.

## Verification evidence

List commands actually executed, results, environment and any checks not run.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe security, privacy, migration and compatibility implications where applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials or real personal data included.
- [ ] Existing acceptance tests were not weakened to obtain a pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the actual implementation.
- [ ] Remaining blockers and assumptions are disclosed.
